file-read.fallback: Ask the runtime for the smallest relevant file excerpt; if files are inaccessible, keep repository-dependent claims UNKNOWN.

file-write.fallback: Produce a patch/spec rather than claiming mutation; release remains BLOCKED for tasks requiring applied changes.

runtimes.generic: native file mutation tool when exposed

test-execution.fallback: Provide exact commands but record tests as UNEXECUTED; do not convert expected output into evidence.

browser-inspection.fallback: Use inspectable screenshots or static artifact analysis and narrow runtime/interaction claims.

runtimes.codex: preferred browser capability available to the runtime; fall back to Playwright only when native inspection is unavailable

screenshot-capture.fallback: Request/provide an external capture; fidelity claims remain UNKNOWN without an inspectable render.

semantic-tree.fallback: Inspect source semantics plus keyboard behavior if possible; mark assistive-technology runtime behavior UNKNOWN.

runtimes.codex: browser accessibility snapshot/semantic inspection when supported

subagent-review.fallback: Use a fresh logical critic pass with generator context minimized; disclose that reviewer independence is weaker.

component-retrieval.fallback: Inspect the local component system directly; do not invent a library component that was not verified.

runtimes.codex: registry/MCP such as project-configured component tooling
runtimes.claude-code: registry/MCP such as project-configured component tooling
